name: Kalani Matai
description:
Naima Orlov-Twumasi is either the future of private investigation or an ethical catastrophe in progress, depending on who you ask. She built MeridianEyes, a mesh-based platform that crowdsources investigative work to a network of over 30,000 gig participants across all five tiers of GLMZ. When a case comes in, she breaks it into hundreds of tiny, anonymized tasks — confirm a sighting, photograph a location, check a public record, note an anomaly — and distributes them to participants who earn micro-bounties for completing them.

The results are staggering. She solves cases faster than any individual investigator, covers more ground than any surveillance system, and generates more data points than any corporate intelligence operation. Her missing-persons recovery time averages eleven hours. Her platform has been used for everything from finding lost pets to tracking corporate fugitives, and it processes over 50,000 micro-tasks per week.

The ethical questions are equally staggering. MeridianEyes turns every participant into an unwitting surveillance node. The platform's anonymization protocols mean participants don't know what case they're contributing to or who benefits from their observations. Privacy advocates have called it 'distributed totalitarianism.' Naima argues that every participant is voluntary, every task is legal, and the platform includes safeguards against misuse. She's mostly right. The 'mostly' keeps her up at night, though she'd never admit it.
affiliation: Operates 'MeridianEyes' — a mesh-based platform that crowdsources investigative work to thousands of gig participants
location: A co-working space in Burnside Corridor that she treats as her command center — multiple screens, standing desk, energy drinks, near Milwaukee and North Ave
specialization: Crowdsourced investigation — breaking cases into micro-tasks distributed to thousands of gig workers
methods: Breaking investigations into hundreds of small, discrete tasks distributed anonymously to gig workers
Using algorithmic task assignment to ensure no single participant sees enough to compromise the case
Paying micro-bounties for specific pieces of information — Φ5 for a confirmed sighting, Φ20 for a photograph
Aggregating thousands of data points from distributed observers into unified intelligence
Using game-theory models to incentivize accurate reporting and penalize false leads
notable_cases: Located a missing corporate employee in under four hours by offering micro-bounties to 12,000 participants — someone spotted them in a Shelf coffee shop and the sighting was confirmed by three other participants within minutes
Mapped the complete daily routine of a Tier 4 fraud suspect using crowdsourced observations from hundreds of gig workers who didn't know they were all watching the same person

Solved a cold case that had been open for eleven years by distributing the evidence to thousands of amateur analysts and offering a Φ50,000 bounty for the solution — a retired accountant in the Narrows found the financial discrepancy that broke it
equipment: MeridianEyes platform — her custom-built mesh application for distributing investigative tasks
Algorithmic task-partitioning software that breaks cases into compartmentalized micro-tasks
Reputation scoring system that weights participant reliability based on historical accuracy
Automated payment processing for micro-bounties — handles thousands of transactions per case
Data aggregation and visualization tools for synthesizing crowdsourced intelligence
personality: Naima is Sudanese-Russian-Ghanaian, thirty-one years old, with dark skin, braided hair she keeps short for practicality, and the manic energy of someone who runs on caffeine and the conviction that she's building the future. She believes that the traditional PI model is dead — one person with one perspective can't compete with a thousand people with a thousand perspectives. She is ambitious, impatient, and occasionally ruthless about efficiency. She treats investigation as an engineering problem and people as data sources, which makes her effective and sometimes callous. She is aware of the ethical problems with her platform — privacy concerns, false accusations, the gamification of surveillance — and addresses them with technical solutions that satisfy her but trouble ethicists.

relationships.name: Yelena Okafor-Chen
relationships.description: The data-tracker PI considers MeridianEyes crude but effective — Naima considers Yelena's solo approach elegant but unscalable

relationships.name: Advocate Rashid Sandstrom-Badu
relationships.description: A privacy rights lawyer who is building a case to shut down MeridianEyes — Naima considers him a speed bump, which is a mistake

story_hooks: MeridianEyes is hijacked by someone who uses the platform to coordinate a massive crime — thousands of unwitting participants become accomplices in something terrible

A participant in the platform is murdered because the task they completed inadvertently revealed their identity to a dangerous subject — Naima faces the consequences of her 'anonymization is sufficient' philosophy
A rival platform launches with better technology and no ethical constraints — Naima has to decide whether to compromise her principles to compete or watch her creation become obsolete

physical_description.heritage: Pacific Islander dominant (47.6%) with significant Middle Eastern (25.0%), Hispanic/Latin American (13.5%), Eastern European (8.8%), and Sub-Saharan African (5.1%) ancestry. This creates a striking polychromatic blend: warm bronze-golden undertones from Pacific Islander heritage mixed with olive and amber warmth from Middle Eastern lineage, enriched by the depth of African and Latin American ancestry, with subtle cool undertones from Eastern European genetics.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, tense musculature from long hours at standing desks and stress. Shoulders slightly hunched forward from habitual posture over interfaces.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with subtle auburn undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, utilitarian braid; a few strands always escaping near her temples
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-bronze with olive undertones, deeper and richer than medium brown. Sun-kissed warmth characteristic of Pacific Islander heritage, layered with amber and ochre notes from Middle Eastern and Latin American ancestry.
physical_description.complexion: Strong, prominent cheekbones with defined jawline reflecting Pacific Islander structure. Warm, luminous skin beneath fatigue — faint shadows under eyes from irregular sleep patterns. A thin scar runs along her left temple to ear (old head trauma, partially covered by hair). Minimal makeup, functional grooming.
distinguishing_marks: Linear scar along left temple extending to ear, approximately 8cm, pale and well-healed
Small burn mark on right forearm (inside wrist), circular, diameter ~1.5cm, from old neural interface calibration accident
Faint tattoo on inside left wrist: a stylized crosshair or target symbol in dark blue-grey ink, approximately 2cm across
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Subcutaneous neural interface port at base of skull (barely visible at nape, thin metallic outline under skin). Subtle LED ring around left pupil (augmented optical nerve for low-light data processing) — only noticeable when light hits it directly. No obvious chrome or external modifications.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical, restless. Hands frequently gesture as if manipulating invisible interfaces mid-air (haptic muscle memory). Eyes dart constantly, scanning environments as if cataloging details. Sits with spine curved, shoulders tense. Walks with purpose, minimal wasted motion.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical: fitted black Helios-brand tactical jacket with asymmetrical pockets (usually over a plain grey or charcoal compression shirt). Dark utility cargo pants with reinforced knees and thigh pockets. Matte black steel-toed boots, worn but maintained. Minimalist silver watch (functional, not decorative) on right wrist. No jewelry. Favors dark, unreflective fabrics. Occasionally wears a faded denim jacket over everything — a relic from before MeridianEyes success.
